steps.what: List street letter boxes on the route
Report unusual circumstances concerning mail delivery
Report the condition of street letter boxes
Sign the condition report
File only the signed condition report
outputs: filed copy of signed condition report v1

tasks.design: A job in {OPS_SYSTEM} lists the street letter boxes on the route. It is not a due list. The carrier reports unusual circumstances and the condition of the boxes. A later job files only the signed report in {DOCS}. A blank condition is not reported as normal.
tasks.previous_blocker: Box conditions were mentioned only if someone asked.
tasks.enabler_now: Box identifier and observed condition are already stored once the carrier reports them.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing the box stays with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides a circumstance is unusual.
tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week observing, not on listing boxes.

reach.task: Read only the report the carrier signed

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.

assumptions: Box identifier is stored on the box record. The box record produces it. The condition is what the carrier reports. A blank condition is not filed as normal. The list is not a due date and not a camera.
Native configuration of the box record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier reporting unusual circumstances concerning mail delivery.

incremental.description: Refresh box identifier when the box layout changes, and drop a report the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many conditions are blank. The high end assumes box identifier is stored and the condition comes from the carrier. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List parcels and letters awaiting those services
Register, certify, and insure parcels and letters
Check the service before it is recorded
Sign the service instruction
File only the signed service instruction
outputs: filed copy of signed service instruction v1

tasks.design: A job in {OPS_SYSTEM} lists parcels and letters awaiting a service. The carrier registers, certifies, and insures them. A later job files only the signed instruction in {DOCS}. It does not register an item by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Services were ticked on a pad after the customer left.
tasks.enabler_now: Item identifier and service type are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Accepting the service stays with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides the service is the one asked for.
tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week at the counter, not on listing items.

reach.task: Receive only the service the carrier signed

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.

assumptions: Item identifier and service type are stored on the service record. The service record produces them. A blank service type is not registered. Only the signed instruction is filed.
Native configuration of the service record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier registering, certifying, and insuring parcels and letters.

incremental.description: Refresh item identifier and service type when the service layout changes, and drop an instruction the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many service types are blank. The high end assumes item identifier and service type are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Travel to offices and relay boxes.

steps.what: List post offices and postal relay boxes
Travel to post offices to pick up the mail
Pick up mail from postal relay boxes
Sign the pickup note
File the signed pickup note
outputs: filed copy of signed pickup note v1

tasks.design: A job in {OPS_SYSTEM} lists post offices and postal relay boxes. The carrier travels there and picks up the mail for the routes. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. The list does not travel, and it does not score the carrier.
tasks.previous_blocker: Pickup points were a verbal list each morning.
tasks.enabler_now: Office identifier and box identifier are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The travel stays with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides the pickup is complete.
tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week traveling, not on listing offices.

reach.task: Hand mail only to the carrier who signed the pickup

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.
Digest [S14] says documents, customs, and routing touch no Annex III area, and scheduling staff by behaviour or traits is high-risk. This design does not schedule or score the carrier.
Digest [S15] says those duties apply from 2 December 2027.

assumptions: Office identifier and box identifier are stored on the pickup record. The pickup record produces them. A blank office identifier is not a stop. The list does not schedule the carrier by behaviour.
Native configuration of the pickup record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier traveling to post offices to pick up the mail.

incremental.description: Refresh office identifier and box identifier when the pickup layout changes, and drop a note the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many office identifiers are blank. The high end assumes office identifier and box identifier are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored stamp values and order amounts
Sell stamps and money orders in person
Take the money only for the stated amount
Sign the sale note
File the signed sale note
outputs: filed copy of signed sale note v1

tasks.design: A job in {ERP} lists stored stamp values and money order amounts. The carrier sells the stamps and money orders and takes the money. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. A blank amount is not sold as zero, and the job does not take the payment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prices were remembered at the counter.
tasks.enabler_now: Item name and amount are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The sale and the cash stay with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides the amount is the one offered.
tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week on the sale, not on listing prices.

reach.task: Pay only the amount the carrier stated

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.

assumptions: Item name and amount are stored on the sale record. The sale record produces them. A blank amount stays blank and is not sold as zero. The job does not take the payment.
Native configuration of the sale record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier selling stamps and money orders in person.

incremental.description: Refresh item name and amount when the sale layout changes, and drop a note the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many amounts are blank. The high end assumes item name and amount are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The carrier spends the week on the route, with the mail, and on the signed note. A stored list and filing that signature can move. The carrier still walks, sorts, collects, and signs.
reach: A patron receives only the mail the carrier delivered.
A publisher receives only the form the carrier signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a redirect the carrier has not signed.
Reject a receipt when the label does not match.
Reject a charge that treats a blank amount as zero.
role.ambitious_version: A signed hold or address change can be filed the same day, and the carrier still walks the route.
